name: Doctrine Of Hell
overview: The Doctrine of Hell, as presented in Scripture, reveals a solemn reality where both soul and body face destruction beyond this life, emphasizing the fear of God rather than mere human threats (Matthew 10:28). Jesus contrasts the eternal destinies of the unrighteous and the righteous, highlighting everlasting punishment for the former and eternal life for the latter (Matthew 25:46). The account of the rich man in Luke 16:19 illustrates the tangible consequences of one's earthly life in the afterlife, underscoring the seriousness of eternal judgment.
